subject: Processor security annex & DPIA mapping request
messages:
From: Sara Lindström <sara.lindstrom@nordwestbank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Gavin Ellis <gavin.ellis@trustaudit.co>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 12:13:00 +0000
Subject: Processor security annex & DPIA mapping request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking my call this morning. Nordwest's security team is compiling our onboarding packet and we have a short list of artifacts needed to complete our DPIA and Article 28 review. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following and an expected delivery date?

- Current subprocessor inventory (include country, role, and date of last contractual update)
- A sample Art. 28/30 processing ledger that illustrates the inference request -> response flow (we will redact customer specifics)
- A DPIA mapping (template or completed example) showing data categories, lawful basis, retention, and processing purposes for the inference pipeline
- Confirmation of data-at-rest encryption and KMS provider (key rotation cadence)
- Your standard data transfer mechanisms (SCCs, adequacy, or other), and fallback behavior for EU->US failover

If possible we need these materials by EOD Thu 25 Jun. If not, next Tue 29 Jun is acceptable. We may request a 30–45m walkthrough for our privacy team once we review the docs.

Thank you,
Sara Lindström
Head of Information Security
Nordwest Bank
[Attachment: nordwest_onboarding_checklist_v3.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lindström <sara.lindstrom@nordwestbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Processor security annex & DPIA mapping request

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear list and for the call. We can provide all of the items you requested. Plan below: 

1) Subprocessor inventory: Marissa will attach the CSV export with country and last-contract date.
2) Art. 28/30 ledger: we will share a sanitized PDF sample that maps processing activities to legal basis and data categories.
3) DPIA mapping: attached is our standard DPIA mapping template; we can also fill a short example for the inference path if you prefer.
4) Encryption/KMS: we use AWS KMS for hosted keys; we will provide KMS key policy summary and rotation cadence (90 days for CMKs).
5) Transfers: we support SCCs and have an SSH-based fallback routing policy — we will include the transfer annex guidance.

We will send the initial package by EOD Mon 22 Jun; if you need sooner we can accelerate but will need to redact some telemetry logs. Happy to set a 30m walkthrough the week of 22 Jun.

Jonas
Head of Privacy & Compliance (Redwood Inference)
[Attachment: redwood_dpia_mapping_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lindström <sara.lindstrom@nordwestbank.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Processor security annex & DPIA mapping request — subprocessor inventory

Hi Sara,

Attached is our current subprocessor inventory export as requested. It includes: name, role, primary country, and the date of last contractual update. Notes: where we rely on cloud providers for infrastructure we list them as "infrastructure provider" and include the region.

Attachment: redwood_subprocessor_inventory_20260601.csv (text/csv)

If you need the commercial contact for any specific provider we can include that in a follow-up.

Best,
Marissa
Vendor & Legal Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Lindström <sara.lindstrom@nordwestbank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Gavin Ellis <gavin.ellis@trustaudit.co>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 12:34:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Processor security annex & DPIA mapping request — quick clarification

Jonas / Marissa — thank you, received the inventory. Quick clarifications from our privacy team after a first pass: 

- For the Art. 28 sample, can you include column(s) that map each processor activity to the Article 28 clause and the legal basis? That's the format our auditors prefer.
- Regarding telemetry/telemetry logs: we prefer example request/response sizes and retention windows rather than live logs; will the sample ledger show tokenization/retention fields?
- For KMS: can you confirm whether customer keys are supported for Dedicated customers (we may request a dedicated key in our final DPA)?

Also, when you send the SCC/transfer annex can you include the date of your most recent transfer impact assessment?

If possible we'd like the expanded sample and answers by Tue 23 Jun so our internal checklist can move forward.

Regards,
Sara

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lindström <sara.lindstrom@nordwestbank.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Processor security annex & DPIA mapping request — materials and next steps

Sara — thanks for the notes. Action items and timings from our side: 

- Updated Art.28/30 sample (with clause mapping + legal basis) — will be delivered Wed 24 Jun EOD (art28-30_ledger_sample.pdf).
- DPIA mapping example: we'll add tokenization and retention columns to the example and include typical request/response size ranges (sanitized) — included in the updated DPIA template.
- KMS/cust. keys: Dedicated customers can bring their own CMK (BYOK). We'll include a short BYOK guide and the current rotation cadence for Redwood-managed keys.
- Transfer impact assessment: our last assessment was completed 2026-03-10; we'll attach the cover summary with dates.
- Walkthrough: proposing Thu 25 Jun 14:00–14:45 CET — I'll send a calendar invite.

I'll upload the package to the Drive folder and share the link with you shortly. Let us know if Nordwest prefers the materials over DocuSign NDAs before sharing anything redacted.

Best,
Jonas
Head of Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEFgh-DPIA-templates ]
